context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 121 tested the new Admin Subscription Management page at /admin/subscriptions. Key findings: (1) Backend endpoint GET /api/admin/subscription/sellers works correctly with all filters (search, plan_filter, pagination). (2) Response structure includes: sellers array with userId, email, name, companyName, plan, effectivePlan, status, isExpired, endDate, overrides, defaultLimits, effectiveLimits, usage (panels/rules counts). (3) Override CRUD integration works: POST sets overrides, DELETE clears them, changes reflect in sellers list. (4) Frontend had TypeScript error with SellerLimits type casting - fixed by adding 'unknown' intermediate cast. (5) Frontend page is behind Firebase auth gate - redirects to login when accessed without authentication. (6) Admin layout includes 'Subscriptions' nav item with CreditCard icon.
features_tested: Override changes reflect in sellers list
